description: Central Province - Notifying that the By-laws relating to Disaster Management in Municipal Councils, Urban Councils and Pradeshiya Sabhas of Central Province published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1960/70 of 01.04.2016 has been seconded
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the adoption of by-laws relating to Disaster Management for local authorities in the Central Province. It involves regulatory matters (by-laws) made under specific Acts of Parliament (Local Authorities Act and Provincial Councils Act), which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
